name: Arrowhead Seperation Engineeri
summary: Arrowhead Seperation Engineering Ltd. manufactures and globally exports a variety of industrial drying machinery, specifically vacuum double drum, rotary, and paddle dryers. The company's operations encompass the design and fabrication of diverse chemical processing equipment, holding particular expertise in continuous drying and cooling system solutions. Their product offerings include drum dryers, rotary dryers, flaker systems, and zero liquid discharge systems. Established on July 25, 1991, the firm maintains its main office in Mumbai, India.
